Nina Lee: Heads-up: I opened a tiny PR to improve the troubleshooting page for 429s, timeouts, and context limits. Goal: one compact Python snippet, one short migration blurb, and two link fixes. @Owen @Priya please eyeball.

Owen Park: Okay. Can you include an example that respects Retry-After and falls back to a lower-cost model? That's what most users ask for.

Priya Singh: Also call out that the runtime uses 'context trim' (not 'clip') now — we should normalize that term and add an anchor to the err-ref page.

Nina Lee: Agreed on both. Drafting a Python snippet like this: 

```py
# minimal retry respecting Retry-After + fallback
import time
from datetime import datetime

def parse_retry_after(hdr):
    try:
        return int(hdr)
    except Exception:
        return 1

def generate_with_fallback(client, prompt):
    resp = None
    try:
        resp = client.text.generate(model='redwood-1', prompt=prompt)
        return resp
    except Exception as err:
        status = getattr(err, 'status', None)
        hdr = getattr(err, 'headers', {}).get('Retry-After')
        if status == 429:
            wait = parse_retry_after(hdr)
            time.sleep(wait)
            return client.text.generate(model='redwood-1-small', prompt=prompt)
        raise
```

Owen Park: Clean. Remove extra comments before merging to keep the doc compact.

Priya Singh: For the migration blurb I propose ~100 words: emphasize honoring Retry-After, using canaries, and verifying prefix caching to reduce repeated tokens. I'll draft and paste shortly.

Nina Lee: Also updated two outdated links: /guides/batching -> /docs/optimizations/batching and /old/errref -> /docs/troubleshooting/errors. Linkcheck flagged both.

DocsBot: CI: docs-lint OK. linkcheck: 2 redirects found (details: ci/1023). Branch: nina/errref-polish.

QA Runner: Quick QA checklist added to PR: 1) run `./tools/local-build` and open example page, 2) run stress recipe `./tools/stress --rps 150 --dur 20 --model redwood-1`, 3) confirm snippet renders without extra line breaks, 4) verify anchors work.

Priya Singh: Migration blurb (pasted): "When migrating clients, ensure your retry logic honors the server's Retry-After header to avoid hot-loop retries. Prefer incremental backoff and consider automatically routing to a lighter model (e.g., redwood-1-small) when sustained 429s or timeouts occur. Verify prefix/KV cache usage to reduce token volume and run canary traffic to limit rollout impact. These steps reduce both cost and error surface during upgrades."

Owen Park: LGTM. I ran the stress job locally: ~150rps for 20s gave 9% 429s on redwood-1; fallback to redwood-1-small (via the snippet) eliminated visible errors in our harness. Logs: ci/1023-stress.

Nina Lee: Great — I'll tidy wording, squash commits, and merge once CI finishes. Thanks all.
